snippet.title: Soccer Is Football (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Soccer Is Football is a one-button soccer game that combines 2d animations and physics driven ragdolls for a unique mobile gameplay experience.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DreamonStudios.SoccerIsFootball
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/soccer-is-football/id1515517194
